text:
tess: quick alert — deploy-bot paused rc.7 rollout in ap-southeast-1. SBOM generated for the image lacks signature and vuln-scan shows one moderate transitive CVE.

deploy-bot: [auto] rc.7 paused; quarantine initiated. report: https://ci.redwood/reports/1751234567 (sbom + vuln).

marco: paste digest + vuln please?

tess: image: gcr.io/redwood/ingest:rc.7 @ sha256:aa11bb22cc33
SBOM: cosign missing for digest
vuln: transitive -> parser-tool v0.9.1 -> CVE-2025-1234 (moderate), originates from build tooling dev dep.

sara: ops preference is rollback to rc.6 (already signed). avoids touching registry.

marco: compliance check - can we unpublish regionally if rollback fails? @legal-bot

legal-bot: [auto] regional staged-unpublish requires manager approval + audit ticket. Preferred: rollback to a signed digest.

tess: ok i'll roll back ap-southeast to rc.6 and rerun spotlight vuln-scan. ETA 8m.

deploy-bot: [auto] rollback job started (#deploy-1201) -> switching traffic 10% rc.7 -> 0%, 0% -> 10% rc.6.

marco: good. once pinned, run targeted SBOM diff to ensure no exposure.

tess: rollback complete. rc.6 pinned for canary in ap-southeast.

deploy-bot: [auto] vuln-scan on pinned rc.6 -> PASS.

sara: file follow-ups: CI-ops-999 (enforce cosign in release pipeline), SEC-800 (periodic SBOM validation).

tess: i'll attach signature to rc.7 and open hotpatch PR to remove transitive dep from build-tool. scheduling global retry in a 2h change window.

marco: noted, add short release-note blurb mentioning temporary pin and cause.

legal-bot: Manual: if rc.7 remains unpublished >24h, open compliance ticket. otherwise no extra steps for rollback.

all: :thumbsup:
